problem: The boundary wrapper combines link-frame origin positions with CoM velocities. The triggered FL_THIGH has a nonzero authored COM offset, so this is not a point-consistent prediction during rotation.

proposed_work.scope: Use explicit body link-origin positions and the velocities of those same origins; retain the collision envelopes, limits, comparison operators and one-control-step horizon.
proposed_work.missing_api_rule: Fail explicitly if required point-consistent state is unavailable; do not silently fall back to CoM velocity.

proposed_work.scope: Label the velocity reference point; prepare capture of actual COM offsets, body link quaternions, world angular velocities and both link/CoM velocities at the same pre-reset predicate evaluation. Use explicit root link/CoM quantities for future residual accounting.
proposed_work.dependency_freeze: Add ArticulationData and package-resolution source hashes to the next preparation; do not rewrite prior manifests.

proposed_work.scope: Test zero COM offsets, pure translation, nonzero COM during rotation, current/predicted branches, invalid inputs, all-body mapping and reset snapshot preservation.
proposed_work.comparison_rule: Original and corrected flags should agree for zero-offset/pure-translation cases. Differences with rotational COM offsets must match an independent geometric oracle; blanket equivalence to the mixed-point implementation is not required.

proposed_work.scope: Review the corrected evidence contract and freeze a later single-case runtime proposal for separate user approval. No GPU run is included in this offline phase.

prohibited_in_phase: Retrospective changes to historical failure results or frozen hashes
acceptance: Position and velocity refer to the same geometric point and the conversion is independently verified.
Diagnostic reference points and newly discovered dependencies are explicit and frozen.
Relevant CPU checks pass; changed predictions are explained.
Report offline results before proposing another runtime phase.
limitations: Current logs cannot reconstruct exact point-corrected terminal thigh velocity because full body angular velocities/orientations were not captured.
Root integration residual components remain unisolated without suitable physics-substep observations.
authorization_rule: This is the next phase proposal only, pending the user’s per-phase confirmation.
